_: The easiest contribution, and a good first commit. Two sentences.
shortDef: The lumped ohmic resistance of the whole current path, read from the voltage step when current changes.
trap: Two conventions. At a charge-to-discharge reversal the current changes by 2I, so R = ΔV/(2I); from rest it changes by I, so R = ΔV/I. Mixing them is a clean factor-of-two error.
_trap: NOT optional decoration. Every term carries its definition AND the thing people get wrong about it, at equal visual weight. If you cannot name a trap, the term may not need an entry.
